name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct MKV when available, HLS fallback for missing Sub/Dub paths, soft subtitle extraction, and exact TMDB/IMDb verification for anime-movie fallback matching.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME and FlixCloud reference implementations
